metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Sindh province, Pakistan increase in September 21, 2020 compared to September 21, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (radar, cloud-free) over Sindh province (FAO/GAUL level1). Compare composites around 2019-09-21 and 2020-09-21 using a ±6 day window; if empty, expand to ±15 days.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (SAR). Use Otsu threshold on VV (dB) to classify open water.
3. Logic: Check collection sizes (C1), valid pixel counts after processing (C2), and null/NaN results (C3). If valid, compare total water area (km²) 2020 vs 2019 and output A (Yes) or B (No).

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfo(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
    });
  }

  // Otsu thresholding on client-side histogram
  function otsuFromHistogram(h) {
    if (!h || !h.histogram || !h.bucketMeans || h.histogram.length === 0) return null;
    const counts = h.histogram;
    const means = h.bucketMeans;
    const total = counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (total === 0) return null;
    const sum = counts.reduce((acc, c, i) => acc + c * means[i], 0);
    let sumB = 0.0;
    let wB = 0.0;
    let maxVar = -1;
    let threshold = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < counts.length; i++) {
      wB += counts[i];
      if (wB === 0) continue;
      const wF = total - wB;
      if (wF === 0) break;
      sumB += counts[i] * means[i];
      const mB = sumB / wB;
      const mF = (sum - sumB) / wF;
      const betweenVar = wB * wF * (mB - mF) * (mB - mF);
      if (betweenVar > maxVar) {
        maxVar = betweenVar;
        threshold = means[i];
      }
    }
    return threshold;
  }

  async function getSindhGeometry() {
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const sindh = gaul
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Pakistan'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Sindh'))
      .geometry();
    const empty = await getInfo(sindh.isEmpty());
    if (empty) return null;
    return sindh;
  }

  function buildS1Collection(geom, start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('resolution_meters', 10))
      .map((img) => {
        // Basic mask to remove edge/invalids
        const vv = img.select('VV');
        const mask = vv.gt(-50); // remove no-data
        return img.updateMask(mask);
      });
  }

  async function processPeriod(label, geom, centerDate, daysWindow, fallbackDaysWindow) {
    const start = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-daysWindow, 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(daysWindow + 1, 'day');
    let col = buildS1Collection(geom, start, end);
    let size = await getInfo(col.size());
    let usedWindow = daysWindow;
    if (size === 0) {
      const start2 = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-fallbackDaysWindow, 'day');
      const end2 = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(fallbackDaysWindow + 1, 'day');
      col = buildS1Collection(geom, start2, end2);
      size = await getInfo(col.size());
      usedWindow = fallbackDaysWindow;
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} Images: 0 (No data in ±${fallbackDaysWindow}d)`);
      return { status: 'C1' };
    }
    console.log(`${label} Images: ${size} (±${usedWindow}d window)`);

    const img = col.median().select('VV');

    // Valid pixel count (at 1 km to keep light)
    let validCount = await getInfo(
      img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('VV')
    );
    validCount = validCount || 0;
    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} Valid pixels: 0`);
      return { status: 'C2' };
    }

    // Histogram for Otsu threshold (VV in dB)
    const histDict = await getInfo(
      img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.histogram({ maxBuckets: 255, minBucketWidth: 0.2 }),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('VV')
    );
    const thr = otsuFromHistogram(histDict);
    if (thr === null || Number.isNaN(thr)) {
      console.log(`${label} Threshold: invalid`);
      return { status: 'C3' };
    }

    // Water mask and area
    const water = img.lte(ee.Number(thr));
    const waterAreaDict = await getInfo(
      water
        .selfMask()
        .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        })
        .get('VV')
    );
    if (waterAreaDict === null || waterAreaDict === undefined) {
      console.log(`${label} Water area: invalid`);
      return { status: 'C3' };
    }
    const waterArea_km2 = (waterAreaDict || 0) / 1e6;

    // Also compute water pixel count at 1 km for quick validation
    const waterCount = await getInfo(
      water.rename('w')
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        })
        .get('w')
    );

    console.log(`${label} VV Otsu Thr (dB): ${thr.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${label} Valid px (~1km): ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`${label} Water px (~1km): ${Math.round(waterCount || 0)}`);
    console.log(`${label} Water area (km²): ${waterArea_km2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`${label} Cloud %: n/a (SAR)`);

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      waterArea_km2,
      validCount,
      imageCount: size,
      threshold: thr
    };
  }

  try {
    const geom = await getSindhGeometry();
    if (!geom) {
      console.log('Region lookup failed.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    console.log('Region: Sindh, Pakistan');

    const res2019 = await processPeriod('2019-09-21', geom, '2019-09-21', 6, 15);
    if (res2019.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(res2019.status);
      return;
    }
    const res2020 = await processPeriod('2020-09-21', geom, '2020-09-21', 6, 15);
    if (res2020.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(res2020.status);
      return;
    }

    // Validation for NaN/invalid
    const v1 = res2019.waterArea_km2;
    const v2 = res2020.waterArea_km2;
    if (
      v1 === null || v2 === null ||
      v1 === undefined || v2 === undefined ||
      Number.isNaN(v1) || Number.isNaN(v2) ||
      v1 < 0 || v2 < 0
    ) {
      console.log('Invalid results.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = v2 - v1;
    console.log(`Δ Water area (2020-2019) km²: ${diff.toFixed(1)}`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
